name: Alien Ant World
storyline: The AI originally conquered various planets but underestimated the ants. The ants initially felt using weaponry was "beneath them" before realizing they needed to build their own robots to compete with the AI's mechanical forces.
summary:
The story centers on a battle between a powerful AI that has conquered multiple planets and a fierce species known as "alien ants".
Robotic Combat: Both the AI and the ants utilize robotic fighting machines on the battlefield. While the ants initially felt weaponry was beneath them, they eventually created their own robots to compete with the AI.
Gameplay Mechanics: It is primarily a shooter-style game where players must destroy AI-controlled robots across vast, open environments.
